_about: Hand-checked against the printed form (page image), one reason per entry. 'exclude' removes a token that is not a line (a reference, a department-use box, a wrapped number); 'caption' replaces a caption the geometry got wrong. Keys are line@page. Every key must still match a token the adapter finds - the extractor fails on a stale one.
